question_cn: 遭遇双将时，被将方唯一合法的应对方式是什么？
question_en: When facing double check, what is the only legal response?

options.text_cn: 用棋子挡住其中一个将军
options.text_en: Block one of the checking lines with a piece
Capture one of the checking pieces
Move the king; only a king move can answer double check
Either block the check or capture a checking piece

explanation_cn: 双将时只能逃王！一步棋无法同时阻挡两路将军，也无法同时吃掉两个攻击子。因此移王是唯一出路——这正是双将威力强大的核心原因。
explanation_en: Against double check, the king must move. A single move cannot block both checking lines or capture both attackers. This forced king move is the key source of double check's power.
